patterns.usage_note: With verbs of giving, telling and receiving, から names the side the action originates from, so 私から説明します presents you as the one taking the initiative. Against に in the same slot (先生に聞いた / 先生から聞いた), から foregrounds the source as an active starting point rather than a mere point of contact, and it is preferred when the source is an institution (学校から通知が届いた).

examples.ruby: その知[し]らせは本人[ほんにん]から直接[ちょくせつ]聞[き]いた。
examples.english: I heard that news straight from the person himself.

examples.ruby: まず私[わたし]から自己紹介[じこしょうかい]させてください。
examples.english: Let me start things off by introducing myself.

examples.ruby: 奨学金[しょうがくきん]の結果[けっか]は大学[だいがく]から郵送[ゆうそう]で届[とど]いた。
examples.english: The scholarship results arrived from the university by post.
